crossRefs.note: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow, not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.
For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that…
For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe…
For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you…
Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,
that your rejoicing may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the…
I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ, that I didn’t run in vain nor…
Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.
For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?
For you are our glory and our joy.
who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,
to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: as also you acknowledged us in part, that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.
translations.bsb: as you have already understood us in part, that you may boast of us just as we will boast of you in the day of our Lord Jesus.
translations.kjv: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.
translations.asv: as also ye did acknowledge us in part, that we are your glorying, even as ye also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.
